rationale.why_matches: Curry sits at the extreme end of p3a_rate and ts_pct with high usage. Thompson shares the same system and shooting profile. Lillard mirrors the usage+p3a_rate+ts_pct fingerprint as a ball-dominant guard who creates his own shot from deep.
rationale.why_exclusions: Defensive bigs like Gobert and Jordan score near zero on p3a_rate, near zero on assist proxy, and are low-usage — the opposite profile on almost every feature dimension.

description: Pass-first offensive center with high usage

rationale.why_matches: Jokic is extreme on assist_pct_proxy for a big man, combined with high defrb_pct, high usage, and strong ts_pct. Sabonis is the most statistically similar player in the league — high assists for a big, dominant rebounding, similar usage band.
rationale.why_exclusions: Hield and Harris are pure perimeter shooters: high p3a_rate, near-zero blocks and drb_pct, low assist proxy. They are incompatible on every interior dimension.

description: Paint-anchored shot-blocking center, minimal offensive role

rationale.why_matches: Gobert scores at the extreme on blocks and defrb_pct, with near-zero p3a_rate, very low usage, and minimal assist proxy. Turner and JJJ share the shot-blocking center archetype — high blocks, high drb, low perimeter involvement.
rationale.why_exclusions: Curry and Lillard are maximal on p3a_rate, high usage, and high assist proxy. They share zero features with a low-usage rim protector.

description: Dominant paint attacker — extreme ftr, low 3-point rate, high blocks

rationale.why_matches: Giannis sits at the extreme end of ftr, very high usage, near-zero p3a_rate, strong blocks, and high defrb_pct. Zion shares the same fingerprint: elite ftr, high usage, low p3a_rate, paint-first aggression.
rationale.why_exclusions: Harris and Robinson are defined by high p3a_rate, very low ftr, low usage, and near-zero blocks — the direct opposite of a paint-dominant player on every key feature.

rationale.why_matches: Thompson has high p3a_rate, low ftr (no foul-drawing), low assist proxy, and moderate usage — the textbook 3-and-D/shooting wing profile. Robinson and Hield are the archetypal comps: defined almost entirely by volume shooting from deep with minimal ball-handling.
rationale.why_exclusions: Jokic and Gobert are interior bigs with near-zero p3a_rate, high rebound rates, and either high assist proxy (Jokic) or high blocks (Gobert). Incompatible on every dimension.

description: Pass-first point guard — elite assist rate, controlled usage

rationale.why_matches: Paul scores extremely high on assist_pct_proxy with moderate usage, moderate ts_pct, and very low blocks and drb_pct. Lowry and Conley share the pass-first guard footprint: high assist rate relative to usage, perimeter player with minimal interior presence.
rationale.why_exclusions: Gobert and Jordan are defined by interior rebounding, blocks, and near-zero assist proxy. A pass-first guard and a rim-running center share nothing in the advanced_v1 space.

description: High-usage versatile wing — combines scoring, playmaking, and athleticism

rationale.why_matches: LeBron combines elite usage, high assist_pct_proxy, strong ts_pct, and balanced rebounding — the rarest combination in the feature space. Doncic mirrors the usage + playmaking + efficiency fingerprint almost exactly. Durant shares the elite ts_pct and high usage, though with less assist volume.
rationale.why_exclusions: Gobert is a low-usage rim protector — the inverse on usage, assist proxy, and p3a_rate. Thompson is a spot-up shooter with low assist proxy — incompatible on the playmaking dimension.

description: Spot-up perimeter shooter — high efficiency, minimal creation

rationale.why_matches: Harris has high p3a_rate, strong ts_pct, very low ftr, low assist proxy, and moderate minutes — a clean catch-and-shoot wing fingerprint. Robinson is the closest archetype in the league. Bogdanovic adds volume scoring from the perimeter with similar efficiency.
rationale.why_exclusions: Giannis and Jokic are high-usage primary ball-handlers with extreme interior metrics. They share none of the perimeter-shooter dimensions.

description: High-usage scoring big — combines interior scoring with foul drawing

rationale.why_matches: Embiid has elite ftr, high usage, good ts_pct, strong blocks, and high defrb_pct. Towns shares the scoring-big profile: high ts_pct, elevated ftr, and interior rebounding. Davis brings similar blocks + defrb + usage combination.
rationale.why_exclusions: Paul is a low-usage pass-first guard with near-zero blocks. Thompson is a shooter with minimal interior presence. Neither approaches Embiid's interior metrics.

description: Regression guard — Jokic should remain unique across seasons

rationale.why_matches: This is a cross-season stability check. Jokic's archetype (passing big) should produce consistent comps year over year. Sabonis should remain the closest match regardless of season.
rationale.why_exclusions: Guards with high p3a_rate should never appear — this case detects if z-score normalization collapses or feature derivation breaks across seasons.
